SELECT nm.id AS noticeMessageId,nd.id AS nodeId,nd.node_name FROM notice_message nm LEFT JOIN notice_node nd ON nm.node_id=nd.id AND nd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE nm.state=#{state} AND nm.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY nm.create_time ASC
